statements.status_notes: The upstream xfsprogs commit https://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/fs/xfs/xfsprogs-dev.git/commit/?id=1c122bbd3c88d89695d3b60c1070d87073d56121 removes the eval of argument strings in xfs_admin, which is the issue behind this CVE. Debian xfsprogs 6.13.0-2+deb13u1 in trixie still lists the CVE as unfixed, and this package includes that upstream change. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-108472
